description: React component 'EmojiManager' for managing emojis, including loading, searching, adding via upload, and removing emojis using API calls.

methods.name: normalizeList
methods.description: Normalizes raw emoji data into a consistent structure with image-based emojis.

methods.name: seedCount
methods.description: Generates a usage count seed value based on the emoji's identifier or type.

methods.name: ensureCounts
methods.description: Ensures each emoji in the list has a usage count, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches emoji data from backend API, normalizes it, updates state, and handles errors.

methods.name: openAdd
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog for adding a new emoji.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the add emoji modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving a new emoji to the backend, with validation and state updates.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes an emoji via API call, then reloads the emoji list.
